name: Peanut Butter Tea Cookies
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: roll Pillsbury peanut butter cookie dough

instructions:
Cut into 12 slices, cut each into 4 pieces.
Place 1 in each teabiscuit cupcake pan
Bake 350 for 8-10 min. Remove from oven and immediately press into center of each a bite size miniature peanut butter cup
Takes 2 boxes of peanut butter cups, makes 48.
